notes.note: Searching a Member ID that does not exist returns the Member Search panel with the exact sentence: "No member record found for 99999999. Verify the number and try again." plus a "Return to Member Search" link. This is a legitimate business answer, not a failure.
Submitting Member Search with both fields empty re-renders the form with "Member ID or Last Name is required." — so memberId must always be supplied by the caller.

Member record screen shows a "Share Accounts" grid with columns Account / Type / Nickname / Current Balance / Opened; a member can hold several shares (here SAVINGS and CHECKING), so the SAVINGS balance must be read by matching the row whose Type is SAVINGS, not by position. If a member holds no SAVINGS share, the row is simply absent. The home page also carries an "Administration — restricted" link which is not part of this flow.

Sign-in failure wording was NOT observed (probing it would have destroyed the working session); the detector for bad credentials is inferred from typical wording and is classified hard/escalate so a caller is told rather than silently looping.

finish.name: Member SAVINGS Balance Lookup
finish.description: Signs in to the Northstar (Meridian Core Servicing 8.4) back-office console with supplied teller credentials, searches Member Servicing for a given Member ID, and returns the current balance of that member's SAVINGS share along with the share account number, member name and member status. Reports "member not found" as a normal business result.
